run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the position of a number among numbers made only of digits 4 and 7
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets to verify correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the while loop with a for loop over string characters
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes positional index by treating 4 as 1 and 7 as 2 in base 2
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it maps strings of 4s and 7s to their sequence position
